product.schneider-t48633.summary: The 486SX tower in the December 1991 German range.
product.schneider-t48633.history: The December 1991 German price list placed the T486/33 in the tower range. The diskless configuration cost DM 8,595 net and the 200 MB version cost DM 10,469. It included MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0.
product.schneider-t48633.technical.confi: Cache accompanied the 33 MHz 486SX. The price list specifies 64 KB of cache, 8 MB of RAM expandable to 16 MB and 512 KB VGA.
product.schneider-t48633.technical.verif: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-t48633.technical.limit: The board still needs to be checked against a specimen and an attributed BIOS preserved. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-t48633.technical.sourc: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1991, pp. 1–3
